tasks.short: Provide human factors expertise on automated vehicle systems.

steps.what: Read the question on interface technology development.
Pull limits of the automated and autonomous systems.
Provide human factors technical expertise in the meeting.
Automotive engineer states the vehicle constraint.
Send the written expertise on the vehicle systems.

tasks.design: Known limits of automated and autonomous systems can be packed in {DOCS} before the meeting. The engineer still provides human factors expertise in the room, with the automotive engineer. Written advice is sent only after that conversation, and only for points that were actually given.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each request started from a search, and the written note drifted from what was said.
tasks.enabler_now: The limit pack can be ready. The meeting stays.
tasks.still_hard: A limit from another vehicle that does not apply to this one.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not send advice the meeting did not give.
tasks.altitude: The advice meeting stays. The engineer can refuse a note that goes beyond what was said.

reach.task: State the vehicle constraint the human role must respect
reach.learn: Which automated functions the person is still expected to take back

evidence.claim: Advice, design and research stay with the engineer; a draft is not the decision.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
Advice about a human role in a vehicle is given in the discussion, not by a pack alone.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from an advice request to sent expertise. Designing the vehicle is out of scope.
Structured fields are question, limit, source study and point actually given. Prior studies produce the limit. Fallback: a point raised only in the meeting is typed and marked as said.
unknowns: Whether the request is about the interface, the human role, or both.
Who may receive the written advice.
research_questions: Which points need a study rather than advice from prior work?

already_counted.description: Keeping the written note to what was said
Dropping limits that do not apply

incremental.description: Keep limit sources findable for the next request

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeated question with prior studies saves the pack. The meeting and the wording of the advice stay. The low case is a new vehicle function with no studies.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop human performance research and investigation protocols.

steps.what: Define measures for the performance analysis.

loop.input: Measure list and the study question
loop.output: Protocol steps, each tied to a measure
loop.check: Engineer cuts a step that collects no agreed measure
loop.stop: One draft; a measure with no step stays open
loop.why_not_simpler: Each study's measures differ, so a fixed protocol is not enough

steps.what: Check consent before the investigation protocol.
Pilot the protocol with one participant.
Release the protocol ready to implement.

tasks.design: A protocol can be drafted in {DOCS} once the measures are chosen. Consent is checked by the engineer, and the protocol is piloted with a person before it is released to implement. A draft that has not been piloted is not issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protocols were copied from the last study and consent was checked late.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting can follow a measure list. Choosing measures, consent and the pilot stay.
tasks.still_hard: A step that collects a measure the consent did not cover.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not release a protocol the pilot showed people cannot follow.

ambition.what: Reuse a protocol on the next study when the measures are the same.

tasks.altitude: The pilot stays. The engineer can refuse release when consent or the pilot fails.

reach.task: Say which protocol steps a validation study already covers
reach.learn: Which steps would duplicate a study that is already approved

evidence.claim: The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.
Recording work so as to check behaviour or performance needs works-council consent.
Advice, design and research stay with the engineer; a draft is not the decision.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a study question to an issued protocol. Running the full study is out of scope.
Test a {DOCS} protocol template before custom code.
Structured fields are measure, step and consent covered or not. The engineer produces the measure list. Fallback: a step the template missed is typed and marked manual.
A protocol that records behaviour needs works-council consent. It is not a performance score.
unknowns: Whether the participant population is already defined.
Who else must accept the protocol.
research_questions: Which measures need an ethics review beyond this check?

already_counted.description: Choosing measures the question did not name

incremental.description: Keep measure names stable when a protocol is reused

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A study with known measures saves the draft. Measure choice, consent and the pilot stay. The low case is a first protocol with no prior measures.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop statistical analysis plans for prototypes and human models.

steps.what: State hypotheses for cockpit designs and workstations.
Develop statistical analysis plans and research methodologies.

loop.output: Analysis plans naming the comparison, the measure and the rule for a result
loop.check: Engineer cuts a test the hypotheses did not ask
loop.stop: One draft; a hypothesis with no test stays open
loop.why_not_simpler: Cockpit and workstation questions do not share one fixed plan

steps.what: Set sample measures for computerized human models.
Statistician checks cockpit designs and workstations.
Issue the plan used to evaluate developmental prototypes.

tasks.design: Hypotheses for cockpit designs, workstations and developmental prototypes stay with the engineer. Statistical analysis plans and methodologies can be drafted in {DOCS}, and sample measures for computerized human models calculated in {SPREADSHEET}. The plan is issued only after the statistician's comment is taken in.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans were copied from the last prototype and sample size was argued at the end.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft plan and a sample table can start from hypotheses. The hypotheses stay.
tasks.still_hard: A plan that is computable and answers a question the prototype did not ask.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not issue a plan whose tests do not match the hypotheses.
tasks.altitude: Stating hypotheses stays. The engineer can refuse a plan the comment showed is the wrong test.

reach.task: Say which cockpit behaviour the prototype can actually show
reach.learn: Which comparisons the rig can run and which exist only in the plan

evidence.claim: A drafted number is usable only when it traces to a record the engineer accepts.
A calculation that runs is not the same as a result the engineer accepts.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a prototype brief to an issued analysis plan. Running the study is out of scope.
Test {SPREADSHEET} sample calculations before custom code.
Structured fields are hypothesis, measure, comparison and sample rule. The brief produces the prototype description. Fallback: a comparison the template missed is typed and marked manual.
The plan is not a result. Issuing it is gated.
unknowns: Whether a statistician is available before issue.
research_questions: Which prototypes need a pilot sample before the plan is fixed?

already_counted.description: Stating hypotheses the brief left open
Cutting tests the hypotheses did not ask

incremental.description: Keep measure names aligned with the prototype log

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A prototype with clear hypotheses saves the draft and the sample table. The hypotheses and the issue check stay. The low case is a new cockpit with no agreed question.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Estimate time and resources for human factors research projects.

steps.what: List human factors research project tasks.
Apply the rate table to resource requirements.
Judge uncertainty in the ergonomic development estimate.

tasks.design: Project tasks can be listed in {PROJECT}, and hours taken from a rate table in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer judges the uncertainty in the ergonomic research estimate. The sponsor receives it only with that judgement attached, not as a single number from the sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hours were copied from the last project and the uncertainty was a sentence at the end.
tasks.enabler_now: The sheet can be filled from tasks and rates. The uncertainty judgement stays.
tasks.still_hard: A neat total that hides a task nobody has done before.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer will not submit an estimate that reads as more certain than the work is.
tasks.altitude: Judging uncertainty stays. The engineer can refuse a total the sheet made look exact.

reach.task: Compare the hour estimate with a line-balance
reach.learn: Which research tasks overlap work the line already times

evidence.claim: A calculation that runs is not the same as a result the engineer accepts.
The engineer stays responsible for a finding that names a hazard, a person, or a design change.

assumptions: Focal role is the human factors engineer. Boundary: from a project brief to a submitted estimate. Staffing the project is out of scope.
Test {SPREADSHEET} rate tables before custom code.
Structured fields are task, rate, hours and uncertainty note. The rate table produces the rate. Fallback: a task with no rate is left uncosted and marked as such.
unknowns: Whether rates exist for this kind of study.
Who the estimate is promised to.
research_questions: Which tasks need a pilot before an hour figure is submitted?

already_counted.description: Judging uncertainty the rate table hides

incremental.description: Keep task names aligned with the rate table

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A project like a previous one saves the task list and the rate sheet. The uncertainty judgement and the submit stay. The low case is a study with no usable rates.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Advice meetings and protocol pilots stay. Analysis plans and hour estimates start from tables.
reach: Automotive engineers on the human role in a vehicle system
skills_to_grow: Saying what the meeting did not conclude
Reusing a protocol only when the measures match
role.ambitious_version: A protocol with the same measures is reused on the next study instead of being rewritten from a blank page.
